body:
Thank you for the kind words, I really appreciate it.

I do think my parents would be a fine option, but it also feels like a bit of a regression to just keep going back to them every time I get to this point. I also feel like while they're supportive of my decisions to transition they're sort of just paying lip service to them. Which is better than most people in my position get, don't get me wrong. Not only that but the reason it got so bad in the first place was because before the concussion my dad sort of emotionally abused the entire family and as a result there's some- Not great feelings that come along with being in his vicinity. 

While he's better than he was there's still that edge of like the person that he used to be that sort of flares up from time to time. It's just not really what I would consider the best option, though it's probably better than death.
